title: tracker criterion add, set and remove, and evidence --json
description: A change to one of an item's criteria (DESIGN.md §2.3, §3), or none, when it already was as asked.

criterion.description: The criterion's number, from 1: the one added, changed or given evidence, or the number the removed one had.

item.description: The item after the change, exactly as its file holds it.
